messages:
Priya Patel: Heads-up — AcmeBank POC asked for a short control mapping + signed pen-test attestation. They specifically want: CC6/CC7 coverage, KMS keyflow diagram, staging egress IPs, and a signed PDF from our pen-test vendor with the date range and a remediation SLA. Can we put together a minimal bundle for them?
Sam Nguyen: @Priya — do they want full SOC2 report or just the control excerpts?
Priya Patel: Just excerpts + mapping to our runtime. Also a short statement that production data is not used in the POC. They insist on a vendor-signed attestation (no internal-only letter).
Carlos Mendez: Ok. I can export the control mapping for CC6/CC7 and redact any customer data. Will need confirm on KMS diagram — do they need full key IDs?
Priya Patel: No raw key IDs. Just key flow (who signs, where keys are stored, KM integration: KMS -> HSM option noted). Example snippet they liked: 
```
KMS flow: user -> app -> KMS (encrypt) -> runtime KV cache (encrypted)
Key material: KMS-managed, no plaintext on disk
```
Sam Nguyen: For the pen-test attestation, our third-party vendor (RedTeamCo) can sign, but standard turnaround is 5 business days for the attestation letter once we request it. If we need faster, there's an expedite fee.
Jo Ramirez: For transfer, recommend secure dataroom link (Box) or presigned S3 with expiry 72h. Do NOT send full logs over email.
SecurityBot: Note: we can include a redacted vuln summary and the last 30 days of centralized audit logs (redacted) — SecurityOps will prepare. Pen-test attestation will include scope statement and date range.
LegalOps: We need to review the attestation wording before sending — include us in the loop. Also confirm they accept vendor-signed letter (no notarization).
Priya Patel: Question on pricing: will providing this bundle (and expedited pen-test letter) affect the POC pricing/PS estimate? Acme asked if there are extra fees.
Carlos Mendez: The standard evidence bundle is included in enterprise POCs. Expedite fee is passed through from the vendor; PS hours for packaging ~2-4 hours (estimate). I can add a line item to the quote.
Sam Nguyen: Timeline plan: 
- Today: collect control mapping + KMS diagram (Carlos)
- +1 day: SecurityOps prepares redacted logs and vuln summary (SecurityBot)
- +2 days: Legal review and package draft (LegalOps)
- +5 business days: vendor signs pen-test attestation (or sooner with expedite)
Priya Patel: Great. I told customer we could get a draft in 48 hours, final signed letter depends on vendor. @LegalOps @SecurityBot please ack when you see this.
Jo Ramirez: Ack — will prepare dataroom template and presigned link procedure.
SecurityBot: Acked. Will queue redaction job (ETA 24-36h).
LegalOps: Reviewing schedule, will aim 24h for draft review.
Priya Patel: Thanks team — I'll update AcmeBank: draft bundle in 48h, signed attestation target 5bd (expedite option available).
Sam Nguyen: FYI sales note: if they want the vendor report plus raw findings, we'll need an SOW. For now keep to attestation + redacted summary.
Priya Patel: perfect. Closing thread for now, will re-open if Acme asks for notarized or on-prem artifacts.
